SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-15: FHIRPath — §6.3 Types. Test these items: is type specifier, is(type), as type specifier, as(type). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.evidence: Fresh FP-15 HISTORIAN probe compared native C++ DuckDB and forced Python fallback. Native returns true for component.value.ofType(Integer).count() = 1 over Observation.component values [valueInteger, valueString, valueQuantity], but fallback returns false. Native returns 3 for arr.ofType(Any).count() / arr.ofType(System.Any).count(), while fallback returns 0. Spec grounding: §3.2 says polymorphic nodes may be filtered by type before navigation; §4.1 defines System.Any as the ultimate root type; §5.2.4 ofType(type) filters by type; §6.3 requires type specifiers to resolve to model types.
issues.root_cause: Forced Python fallback filtering.of_type_fn() only used generic TypeInfo equality/subtype checks. It did not share the System.Any root-type predicate or unqualified choice primitive predicate used by types.is_fn() and types.as_fn(), so Any filters dropped all items and nested value[x] primitive paths lost their resolved choice suffix.
issues.resolution: Updated filtering.of_type_fn() to retain all input for Any/System.Any and to retain ResourceNode choice primitive values when the unqualified type specifier matches the choice suffix. Added native/fallback parity coverage for ofType(Any), ofType(System.Any), and nested component.value.ofType(Integer/String/Quantity).
